name: spectral-split-text
title: Spectral Split Text
description: Two chromatic copies of the headline offset in opposing directions with screen/ multiply blend modes, producing a prism-split edge that intensifies as the offset grows — chromatic aberration as a dial.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Offset Dial: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
